newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France drains 100 mln Ffr at tender.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France drains 100 mln Ffr at tender.

text.p: The Bank of France drained 100 million francs at a securities repurchase tender held on Monday to allocate funds for injection into the money market on Tuesday.
It accepted bids for 35.3 billion francs in new liquidity, 100 million less than the 35.4 billion leaving the market on Tuesday when a previous pact expires. The new pact expires on July 8.
The Bank of France said it allocated 11.1 billion francs to bidders offering Treasury bills as collateral, satisfying 4.6 percent of such demand.
It allotted a further 24.2 billion to bidders putting up private paper, satisfying 11.2 percent of this demand.
